title: Delicious Apple Dumplings
description: This delicious apple dumplings recipe is made with green apples, wrapped in crescent roll dough, baked with a buttery, combo of citrus soda and cinnamon.
ingredients: 2 (8 ounce) packages refrigerated crescent roll dough
4 small Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, and quartered
1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle caffeinated citrus-flavored soda (such as Mountain Dew®)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan.
Heat sugar, butter, cinnamon, and vanilla in a saucepan over medium heat until sugar dissolves, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat; set aside.
Divide crescent roll dough into 16 triangles. Roll 1 apple quarter with 1 dough triangle; arrange in the prepared pan. Pour butter mixture over wrapped apples; pour soda on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 40 to 45 minutes.
